title: xebench benchmarks
description: Canonical cross-engine on-device LLM benchmark results published by xebench. This file is the stable contract for consumers (e.g. the pocketpal.dev leaderboard loads it dynamically). Contract 1.1 is additive over 1.0, 1.2 over 1.1 and 1.3 over 1.2: every 1.0, 1.1 and 1.2 file still validates. Additive changes bump the minor and breaking changes bump the major; consumers must reject a major they do not support. Rows are closed (additionalProperties false), so a consumer validating with this schema must be updated before a producer publishes a new minor's fields. Invariants this schema cannot express (dispersion min <= max, a real calendar generatedAt, one build.runtimes entry per name) are enforced by scripts/lib/publication.mjs.

schemaVersion.description: MAJOR.MINOR of this contract ("1.0" to "1.3"); a different major is unsupported and must be rejected as a whole

generatedAt.description: UTC time the file was last regenerated: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ since 1.1; the date-only YYYY-MM-DD form of 1.0 remains valid

allOf.$comment: build.runtimes, configurationId and configurationSha256 are 1.2 fields: a 1.0 or 1.1 file carries none
dateBasis is a 1.3 field: a 1.0, 1.1 or 1.2 file carries none

device.description: marketing device name, e.g. 'POCO F8 Ultra'

quant.description: quantization scheme, e.g. 'Q4_0', 'W4A16'; ALWAYS surfaced, never hidden

ppTps.description: prefill tokens/sec (null if the source didn't report it); on measured rows the median of sampleCount successful repetitions

tgTps.description: decode tokens/sec (null if not reported); on measured rows the median of sampleCount successful repetitions

provenance.description: who supplied the number: measured = xebench lab run; vendor = engine-maker official published number; community = third-party enthusiast benchmark. Provenance is not validation.

sourceDate.description: YYYY-MM of the source measurement (on a legacy row with dateBasis first-published: the month the row was first published)

dateBasis.description: 1.3, legacy rows only, with sourceDate; not displayed. What sourceDate is: 'measured' = the month the row was measured; 'first-published' = the month the row was first published, because its measurement month cannot be established

sampleCount.description: n successful repetitions behind the medians

asStated.description: human-readable methodology caveats for this row (quant, provenance method, protocol)

validation.description: 1.1, measured rows only. legacy = published before protocol/evidence validation existed; unverified = conditions not verified; failed = a validation or run-condition check failed; verified = guards passed and evidence is linked

guardsPassed.description: 1.1, measured rows only. Run-condition guard outcome: true = passed, false = a condition failed (validation must be failed), null = not verified

conditionPolicy.description: 1.1, measured rows only. Run-condition policy id, e.g. 'observed-conditions-v1'

protocolVersion.description: 1.1, measured rows only. Measurement protocol id, e.g. 'cpu-reference-v1'

configurationId.description: 1.2, measured rows from evidence bundles only. The id of the run configuration the session ran, e.g. 'cpu-reference-v2'

configurationSha256.description: 1.2, measured rows from evidence bundles only, with configurationId. SHA-256 of the configuration file's bytes, as the session recorded it (configurationSource)

timingMethod.description: 1.1, measured rows only. How ppTps/tgTps were timed, e.g. 'engine-timings'

dispersion.description: 1.1, measured rows only; not on legacy rows. Spread of the successful repetitions behind ppTps/tgTps

evidence.description: 1.1, measured rows only; required when verified, absent on legacy rows. Immutable sanitized evidence behind the row

bundleSha256.description: lowercase hex SHA-256 of the evidence bundle

url.description: https URL of the immutable evidence bundle: a host (no credentials), printable ASCII only

build.description: 1.1, measured rows only. Identity of the software that produced the row. With runtimes (1.2), engineVersion and bindingVersion follow the fixed forms below

engineVersion.description: the engine's own version, e.g. 'llama.cpp b11385 (bf9a0cc)', 'LiteRT-LM 0.18.0', 'geniex-android 0.3.1'

runtimes.description: 1.2, measured rows only. Each software component that ran, with its version; one entry per name (enforced by scripts/lib/publication.mjs)

allOf.$comment: 1.1 fields are valid on provenance=measured rows only
verified requires guardsPassed === true and evidence
legacy rows carry no dispersion, evidence or configuration; a measured row without validation (1.0) is legacy
dateBasis: legacy rows only (validation legacy on a measured row), with sourceDate
configurationId comes from an evidence bundle

runtime.description: 1.2. One software component of the row's build

version.description: a llama.cpp build ('b11385') or a dotted version with an optional pre-release ('0.13.0-rc.7', '2.50.0.260828221209'), at most 64 characters

spread.description: finite non-negative tokens/sec; min <= max (enforced by scripts/lib/publication.mjs)
